{{Top|leg}}
A '''mist-gale''' was a type of tempestuous storm that inspired [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]'s song "[[Talcharaim Mist-Night]]."<ref name="Spare Parts">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)|reprint=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mist-gales were mentioned in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[1996]] short story "[[Spare Parts (short story)|Spare Parts]]" that was published by [[West End Games]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Spare Parts" />
